goal: Prevent sensitive records and rotated encryption keys from persisting in wallet database free pages
Ensure deleted or overwritten wallet data is automatically zeroed out by SQLite
agreement: Unaddressed objection: removing VACUUM leaves plaintext keys in existing wallets on encryption (Zippo76)
Verified plaintext keys do not remain after encryption across crash and restart scenarios (fametrano)
Worried global secure deletion adds unnecessary overhead across all wallet workflows (furszy)

categories.name: build
why: P4 because it only adds a compile-time flag to SQLite in the depends recipe
It is a minor dependency build tweak with no wider impact on build system integrity or CI
